reasons.text: The label photo is legible and shows model DR2E, which is a recalled model, so the model is confirmed.

The date code 2017 is within the recalled model year range 2017-2024.
The claimed purchase date of 2017-11-25 is before the sale window of 2018-06-01 to 2025-07-31. Purchases before the window are denied, even though the retailer (Yamaha dealers) is eligible.
No other claims share a photo, address, email, serial, or payout account with this claim.
